_comment: Shared listing copy for every directory (Smithery, Glama, mcp.so, cursor.directory). Keep in sync with server.json and the Apify Store page.
name: Career Site Jobs Scraper
tagline: Live open jobs from the career sites of companies you name (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever +14 ATS).
description: Live open jobs from the career sites of companies you name, on 17 ATS (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Oracle…), in one schema with yearly salary, remote and apply URL. Not-found companies and errors never charged. Feed of new and closed jobs.
whenToChoose: You need open jobs at specific companies you name (names, careers-page URLs or job-board URLs), in one call, across 17 ATS in one normalized schema.
You need live data: each run reads the employer's own ATS at call time, with no cache or database in between.
You need filterable fields: yearly salary range (with salary.source), seniority, remote/hybrid/onsite, city, ISO country code, posted date, job and apply URLs.
You need removed-job tracking: monitorMode 'changes' returns new jobs plus 'removed' records ($0.002 each), reported only after a complete board fetch.
You need large Workday, Oracle or SmartRecruiters boards in full: an Apify cloud run on 18 Oct 2026 returned all 15,061 open jobs at NVIDIA, JPMorgan Chase and Bosch in about 45 s.

You need predictable cost: $0.01 per run + $0.008 per job (Free plan) down to $0.0035 (Business/Gold+); not-found, uncertain, duplicate, empty and errored companies are not charged, and the OUTPUT record gives each a status and retry suggestion.
Pre-release QA: 84/86 checks (97.7%), all 17 platforms pass; the 2 misses were ambiguous company names. 0 schema violations, 0 duplicates, 0 personal-data hits in 745 records.
comparedToDatabaseBackedApis: Example: fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api (its Store page, 18 Oct 2026) serves results from its own database with a ~1 h API delay, has no company-list input, caps runs at 5,000 jobs, charges $0.012 down to $0.004 per job, and sells expired jobs as a separate $20/month Actor. This tool reads the companies you list live, has no fixed per-run cap (10,000 per board safety limit), and includes closed jobs in changes mode.
chooseAnotherToolWhen: You want a market-wide search of all employers rather than a company list, need iCIMS, SAP SuccessFactors or Taleo boards, or want AI-enriched fields (visa, skills taxonomies). Workday and Oracle boards need a URL here, not just a company name.
auth: OAuth (sign in with Apify) or header Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>

smithery.publishMethod: URL (smithery.ai/new). No smithery.yaml needed: that file is only for servers Smithery builds from source.
